about: Facts for the CRA tax increment estimate (/public-money/cra-tax-increment), read by site/page_datasets.py cra_tax_increment(). Yearly increment comes from each CRA's budget_by_year in data/panama_city.json, data/pcb.json, data/lynn_haven.json and data/others.json; millage from data/tax/millage.json. This file holds what those don't: which rows to use, sunset dates and their basis, adopted-budget anchors, the Front Beach Road cap and the official figures the estimate is checked against. Compiled 2026-10-25.

cras.name: Front Beach Road CRA
cras.sunset_basis: Plan extended from 2031 to 2049 by Res. 19-140 (Sept 2019). A 2024 city-county agreement caps yearly CRA revenue at $30M through 2049; a 2020 agreement (Res. 20-85) rebates 20% of county increment above $15M a year to the county.

cras.name: Pier Park CRA
cras.sunset_basis: No end date found. Projected to Sept 30, 2039, the latest date under s.163.3755, F.S. for a CRA that existed in 2019 unless the city votes to continue it. The increment is passed to the Pier Park Community Development District under the 2001 partnership agreement.

cras.name: Panama City CRA
cras.sunset_basis: All four districts are scheduled to sunset in 2044 (2025 plan). Bay County keeps 26% of the increment from the 2025 St. Andrews expansion area (not modeled).

cras.name: Lynn Haven CRA
cras.sunset_basis: Extended from about 2033 to Nov 30, 2043 by Res. 2026-01-504 (Jan 2026).

cras.name: Callaway CRA
cras.sunset_basis: The plan text was not retrieved. Assumes the 30-year plan limit (about 2037); Sept 30, 2039 at the latest under s.163.3755, F.S. unless the city votes to continue it.

cras.name: Springfield CRA
cras.sunset_basis: The plan text was not retrieved. Assumes the 30-year plan limit (about 2037); Sept 30, 2039 at the latest under s.163.3755, F.S. unless the city votes to continue it.

cras.name: Parker CRA
cras.sunset_basis: The plan text was not retrieved. Assumes the 30-year plan limit (about 2034). No positive increment before FY2024.
